name: crossover
description: Running Windows applications and games on a Mac with CodeWeavers CrossOver — bottles, installing listed and unlisted applications, the command-line tools, registry and Wine Configuration changes, Advanced Settings per CrossOver version (23.7–24, 25, 26), debug logs, locale and keyboard fixes, and controllers, anti-cheat, and mods — built from the CodeWeavers Mac knowledge base. Ships a log-triage agent for .cxlog files and a guard against irreversible bottle deletion.
